[EPIC] Upgrade letta-rs SDK for Letta 0.16.x API compatibility
description: The vendored letta-rs SDK (v0.1.3, forked from orual/letta-rs) was last updated for Letta 0.15.1. Our Letta instance is now running 0.16.4 with 186 API endpoints. While existing MCP tool operations still work (archival-memory, sources, agents, tools, etc.), several new API areas are not covered by the SDK. This epic tracks adding support for new 0.16.x APIs and verifying type compatibility.
notes:
Current state:
- SDK: vendored at /opt/stacks/letta-MCP-server/rust/vendor/letta (v0.1.3)
- Fork: github.com/oculairmedia/letta-rs branch add-missing-endpoints (3 commits ahead of upstream)
- Upstream: orual/letta-rs v0.1.2 on crates.io (dormant since Jul 2025)
- Letta API: 0.16.4 running at 192.168.50.90:8283 with 186 endpoints
- OpenAPI spec available at /openapi.json

New 0.16.x API areas not in SDK:
- Archives (/v1/archives/) - 6 endpoints - standalone archive CRUD
- Conversations (/v1/conversations/) - 6 endpoints - new messaging abstraction
- Steps (/v1/steps/) - 7 endpoints - execution step tracking with trace/metrics/feedback
- Runs expanded (/v1/runs/) - 9 endpoints - metrics, usage, trace, stream
- MCP servers v2 (/v1/mcp-servers/) - 7 endpoints - dedicated MCP server management

Existing SDK modules that may need type updates:
- agents.rs (44 API endpoints, check for new fields)
- tools.rs (17 API endpoints, check for new fields)
- sources.rs (11 API endpoints, sources vs archives migration)
- messages.rs (7 API endpoints, check for conversations overlap)

title: Audit SDK types against Letta 0.16.4 OpenAPI spec
description: Compare every type in rust/vendor/letta/src/types/ against the Letta 0.16.4 OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Identify missing fields, renamed fields, changed types, and new enums. This is the prerequisite for all other upgrade work.
notes:
Analysis-mode synthesis:
- Internal OpenAPI (live Letta 0.16.4 at /openapi.json) is source of truth for typing decisions.
- External docs/search had gaps/inconsistencies (e.g. telemetry endpoint discoverability), but live spec definitively includes /v1/telemetry/{step_id}.
- Typing policy used:
  - Strong types where response schemas are explicit (/object with stable fields).
  - Keep serde_json::Value where schemas are free-form/unspecified.

title: Add Steps API module to letta-rs SDK
description: Add support for the new /v1/steps/ API (7+ endpoints). Steps provide execution step tracking with trace data, metrics, feedback, and transaction management.
notes:
Type-tightening pass completed for step-level endpoints:
- Updated rust/vendor/letta/src/api/jobs.rs signatures:
  - list_messages -> LettaResult<Vec<LettaMessageUnion>> (from Vec<serde_json::Value>)
  - get_trace -> LettaResult<Option<TelemetryTrace>> (from serde_json::Value)
  - get_provider_trace -> LettaResult<TelemetryTrace> (from serde_json::Value)
- Existing StepMetrics + ModifyFeedbackRequest retained and used

Schema basis:
- /v1/steps/{step_id}/messages -> array of discriminated Message unions
- /v1/steps/{step_id}/trace -> anyOf(ProviderTrace|null)
- /v1/telemetry/{step_id} -> ProviderTrace object (represented by TelemetryTrace in SDK)

Verification:
- cargo check -p letta ✅
- cargo check (workspace) ✅
- cargo test step_api_creation ✅
- LSP diagnostics clean for api/jobs.rs ✅

title: Expand Runs API module in letta-rs SDK

notes:
Type-tightening pass completed for run-level endpoints using local Letta 0.16.4 OpenAPI:
- Added types in rust/vendor/letta/src/types/runs.rs:
  - RunMetrics (for GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/metrics)
  - UsageStatistics (for GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/usage)
- Updated rust/vendor/letta/src/api/runs.rs signatures:

- Kept run trace/stream endpoints as serde_json::Value due free-form/unspecified response schemas in OpenAPI:
  - /v1/runs/{run_id}/trace => array<object, additionalProperties=true>
  - /v1/runs/{run_id}/stream => empty response schema
